main.*: {{apichanges|5.3.0|prev=5.2.0|next=5.4.0}} == New Features == * You can now control for which specialization you will receive loot from LFR/Quests. * The number of pet stable pages has increased from 2 to 5 (Increasing the number of slots from 20 to 50). * Knowledge base and GM tickets now use an embedded web browser to interact with Blizzard's Support website. ** The embedded browser functionality is encapsulated by the Browser widget type. == Misc Changes == * [[TradeSkillLink|tradeSkillLink]] encoding changed significantly. The first four fields were re-arranged, and specialization data was added for Cooking. == Bugs == * If {{api|InterfaceOptionsFrame_OpenToCategory}}(panel) is called before the addon panels list is updated after adding a new panel, the interface options frame will open to another panel. You can work around this behavior by calling the function twice. {{:Patch 5.3.0/API changes/diff}}
